DailyLog.title: DailyLog
DailyLog.description: Daily record of sleep and seizure tracking for a child.

id.description: The unique document ID (typically the log date in YYYY-MM-DD format).

userId.description: The identifier of the user who recorded this daily log.

date.description: The date of the entry in YYYY-MM-DD format.

sleep.description: Sleep metrics of the child for the previous night.

sleepTime.description: HH:MM format of the sleep time.

wakeTime.description: HH:MM format of the wake time.

hoursSlept.description: Calculated total duration of sleep in hours.

wakeUpCount.description: Number of times the child woke up overnight.

observations.description: Text notes detailing sleep behavior or events.

seizures.description: Detailed log of seizures that occurred during the day.

occurred.description: Whether any seizures occurred on this day.

morningCount.description: Number of seizures in the morning (06:00 - 12:00).

afternoonCount.description: Number of seizures in the afternoon (12:00 - 18:00).

nightCount.description: Number of seizures during the night/dawn (18:00 - 06:00).

totalCount.description: Total seizures today (sum of morning, afternoon, night, or detailed strengths).

triggers.description: Suspected triggers like fever, fatigue, sensory overload, etc.

observations.description: Additional text notes or descriptions of the seizures.

taken.description: Whether scheduled medicines were fully administered.

observations.description: Observations regarding medications (dose changes, refusal, etc.)

users/{userId}/logs/{logId}.description: Stores user-specific historical logs of sleep, seizures, and medications.
